extracted.name: Orange Party Cake
extracted.description: This orange party cake recipe is from my grandmother in Tennessee. She made it for my family on every visit for 25 years. I make it for my family now.
ingredient_lines: 1 (6 ounce) package orange flavored Jell-O® mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan.
Stir gelatin mix and cake mix together in a medium bowl. Add eggs, oil, water, and vanilla; beat with an electric mixer on high speed for 3 minutes. Pour batter into the prepared pan.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. Be careful not to overbake. Cool for 15 minutes in the pan before inverting onto a wire rack to cool completely.
